reviewScope: All 716 still photographs inventoried, fully decoded and visually reviewed in 12 chronological contact sheets. All 83 shortlisted JPEG originals checked again in larger comparison sheets at up to 492 pixels. Both covers opened at 1,000 pixels. Videos and metadata sidecars stay outside the photo albums.
dateSource: Camera-local EXIF DateTimeOriginal; original OffsetTimeOriginal retained where present. No filename or filesystem dates substituted for missing EXIF.
locationNotes: Mandarmani is supported by the supplied collection name and the continuous beach sequence. Nikon clocks have no offset tags; phone originals record +05:30. The unrelated November 2021 indoor portraits remain omitted.

The July 2025 GPS, museum signs and continuous route establish Bolpur, Sonajhuri market area, Prakriti Bhavan, Visva-Bharati and Uttarayan. Photographed house signs name Udayan, Konarka and Udichi. Later Buddha, sculpture-garden, pavilion and pond stops have separate GPS clusters and retain broad Santiniketan or Sriniketan labels instead of being assigned to Prakriti Bhavan.
Surul courtyard and temple photographs cluster near 23.6624 N, 87.6673 E. Later ruins cluster near 23.6247 N, 87.6606 E and correspond to Raipur Rajbari, a separate location.
Shared edited photos with UUID names repeat selected campus and market scenes; compare visually rather than matching faces.
The original Santiniketan folder contains 14 July birthday photographs. They are omitted, so the album ends on the actual last selected date, 13 July.
People and some personal scenes are included without identifying or matching faces; source filenames are listed for later owner review.
criteria: Favor distinct scenery, architecture, art, craft, wildlife, food and daily life; omit most repeated posed portraits.
About ten strong photographs per day/location where suitable choices exist; quality takes priority over quotas.
Count the cover once outside the gallery on its actual capture day.
Preserve framing and colour, correct orientation, retain ICC profiles and remove EXIF/XMP. Export quality-84 WebP at up to 2,000 pixels long edge or 2,400 for the cover.
Keep originals, RAW files, videos, sidecars and review materials outside Git and R2.
